words.gloss: king, minister, country, fort, treasury, army and ally

hindi: स्वामी, अमात्य, जनपद, दुर्ग, कोश, दण्ड और मित्र — ये प्रकृतियाँ हैं।
english: The king, the minister, the country, the fort, the treasury, the army and the ally are the constituent elements (prakṛtis).
notes: jana-pada: 'country' (inhabited territory); daṇḍa here = the army (the instrument of force).
lines_deva: स्वाम्य्.अमात्य.जन.पद.दुर्ग.कोश.दण्ड.मित्राणि प्रकृतयः
lines_iast: svāmy.amātya.jana.pada.durga.kośa.daṇḍa.mitrāṇi prakṛtayaḥ

hindi: उनमें स्वामी की सम्पत् यह है —
english: Among these, the excellence of the king (is as follows):
notes: sampat = the ideal set of qualities ('excellence') of each constituent; the definition follows in the next unit.
lines_deva: तत्र स्वामि.सम्पत्
lines_iast: tatra svāmi.sampat

words.gloss: endowed with fortune, intelligence and spirit

hindi: उच्च कुल में उत्पन्न, दैव, बुद्धि और सत्त्व से सम्पन्न, वृद्धों का आदर करने वाला, धार्मिक, सत्यवादी, वचन न तोड़ने वाला, कृतज्ञ, उदार, महान उत्साह वाला, काम में विलम्ब न करने वाला, वश में रखने योग्य सामन्तों वाला, दृढ़ बुद्धि वाला, क्षुद्र परिषद् से रहित, विनय का इच्छुक — ये आभिगामिक गुण हैं।
english: Born of a high family, endowed with fortune, intelligence and spirit, heeding the elders, righteous, truthful in speech, not breaking his word, grateful, liberal and of large aims, of great energy, not dilatory, having controllable neighbouring princes, of firm mind, not having a mean council, desirous of training: these are the qualities that draw people to him (ābhigāmika qualities).
notes: sthūla-lakṣa: literally 'of large aim/mark', taken as 'liberal, munificent'. vinaya-kāma: 'desirous of discipline/training'. ābhigāmika: qualities by which people approach (abhigam) the king, i.e. attracting qualities.
lines_deva: महा.कुलीनो दैव.बुद्धि.सत्त्व.सम्पन्नो वृद्ध.दर्शी धार्मिकः सत्य.वाग् अविसंवादकः कृतज्ञः स्थूल.लक्षो महा.उत्साहो ऽदीर्घ.सूत्रः शक्य.सामन्तो दृढ.बुद्धिर् अक्षुद्र.परिषत्को विनय.काम इत्य् आभिगामिका गुणाः
lines_iast: mahā.kulīno daiva.buddhi.sattva.sampanno vṛddha.darśī dhārmikaḥ satya.vāg avisaṃvādakaḥ kṛtajñaḥ sthūla.lakṣo mahā.utsāho 'dīrgha.sūtraḥ śakya.sāmanto dṛḍha.buddhir akṣudra.pariṣatko vinaya.kāma ity ābhigāmikā guṇāḥ

words.gloss: desire to learn, listening, grasping, retaining, understanding, reasoning, rejecting, devotion to truth

hindi: सुनने की इच्छा, सुनना, ग्रहण करना, धारण करना, विशेष रूप से जानना, ऊह, अपोह और तत्त्व के प्रति निष्ठा — ये प्रज्ञा के गुण हैं।
english: Desire to learn, listening, grasping, retention, understanding, reasoning (ūha), rejection of the false (apoha) and devotion to truth are the qualities of intellect.
notes: ūha and apoha: reasoning for and against (inference and exclusion); rendered literally.
lines_deva: शुश्रूषा.श्रवण.ग्रहण.धारण.विज्ञान.ऊह.अपोह.तत्त्व.अभिनिवेशाः प्रज्ञा.गुणाः
lines_iast: śuśrūṣā.śravaṇa.grahaṇa.dhāraṇa.vijñāna.ūha.apoha.tattva.abhiniveśāḥ prajñā.guṇāḥ

hindi: शौर्य, अमर्ष, शीघ्रता और दक्षता — ये उत्साह के गुण हैं।
english: Valour, indignation, quickness and dexterity are the qualities of energy.
lines_deva: शौर्यम् अमर्षः शीघ्रता दाक्ष्यं च-उत्साह.गुणाः
lines_iast: śauryam amarṣaḥ śīghratā dākṣyaṃ ca-utsāha.guṇāḥ

words.gloss: possessed of memory, intellect and strength
in adversity and in the normal state
seeing far in time and space
giving importance to place, time, human effort and the task
discriminating between peace, valour, giving up, restraint, bargaining and the enemy's weak points
whose glance is not downcast, derisive, crooked or frowning
free from desire, anger, greed, obstinacy, fickleness, vexing others and slander
speaking with a smile and with dignity
whose conduct follows the counsel of elders

hindi: वाक्पटु, निर्भीक, स्मृति, मति और बल से युक्त, उन्नत, आत्मसंयमी, शिल्पों में प्रशिक्षित, व्यसन-रहित, सेना का नेतृत्व करने वाला, उपकार और अपकार का उचित प्रतिकार देखने वाला, लज्जाशील, आपत्ति और सामान्य स्थिति में लोगों को नियुक्त करने वाला, दीर्घ और दूर तक देखने वाला, देश, काल, पुरुषार्थ और कार्य को प्रधानता देने वाला, सन्धि, विक्रम, त्याग, संयम, पण और शत्रु के छिद्रों का भेद जानने वाला, गुप्त बातें छिपाकर रखने वाला, जिसकी दृष्टि दीन, उपहास-पूर्ण, कुटिल या भृकुटी वाली न हो, काम, क्रोध, लोभ, हठ, चंचलता, दूसरों को कष्ट देने और चुगली से रहित, सौम्य, मुस्कान और गौरव के साथ बोलने वाला, वृद्धों के उपदेश के अनुसार आचरण करने वाला — यह आत्म-सम्पत् है।
english: Eloquent, bold, possessed of memory, intellect and strength, lofty, self-controlled, trained in the arts, free from vices, a leader of the army, seeing the fitting return for benefit and for injury, possessed of modesty, employing men in adversity and in the normal state, far-seeing in time and space, giving importance to place, time, human effort and the task, able to distinguish between peace, valour, giving up, restraint, bargaining and the enemy's weak points, reserved, whose glance is not downcast, derisive, crooked or frowning, free from desire, anger, greed, obstinacy, fickleness, vexing others and slander, pleasant (śakla), speaking with a smile and with dignity, whose conduct follows the counsel of elders: this is personal excellence (ātma-sampat).

text_flags.why: possible: the member is saṃyama (restraint); 'samyama' with a plain m before y is non-standard, but may be the e-text's own convention

notes: śaklaḥ: a word of unclear meaning; kept as given and glossed 'pleasant' tentatively (some take it as 'affable'); a reviewer may want to compare the print. bhrukuṭī.kṣaṇaḥ: the last member is īkṣaṇa 'glance' (bhrukuṭī + īkṣaṇa with ī+ī sandhi), so the e-text's dot cuts inside the member; no text change. su-avagraha: 'well restrained' taken as self-controlled; alternative 'easily restrained/amenable'. upakāra-apakārayoḥ could also be loc. du. parac.chidra = para-chidra with c-ch sandhi. upatāpa glossed 'vexing others' (literal: causing pain); alternative 'hastiness'. Hindi renders śakla tentatively as 'सौम्य' (pleasant); the word's meaning is unsettled.
lines_deva: वाग्मी प्रगल्भः स्मृति.मति.बलवान् उदग्रः स्व्.अवग्रहः कृत.शिल्पो ऽव्यसनो दण्ड.नाय्य् उपकार.अपकारयोर् दृष्ट.प्रतीकारी ह्रीमान् आपत्.प्रकृत्योर् विनियोक्ता दीर्घ.दूर.दर्शी देश.काल.पुरुष.कार.कार्य.प्रधानः सन्धि.विक्रम.त्याग.सम्यम.पण.परच्.छिद्र.विभागी संवृतो ऽदीन.अभिहास्य.जिह्म.भ्रुकुटी.क्षणः काम.क्रोध.लोभ.स्तम्भ.चापल.उपताप.पैशुन्य.हीनः शक्लः स्मित.उदग्र.अभिभाषी वृद्ध.उपदेश.आचार इत्य् आत्म.सम्पत्
lines_iast: vāgmī pragalbhaḥ smṛti.mati.balavān udagraḥ sv.avagrahaḥ kṛta.śilpo 'vyasano daṇḍa.nāyy upakāra.apakārayor dṛṣṭa.pratīkārī hrīmān āpat.prakṛtyor viniyoktā dīrgha.dūra.darśī deśa.kāla.puruṣa.kāra.kārya.pradhānaḥ sandhi.vikrama.tyāga.samyama.paṇa.parac.chidra.vibhāgī saṃvṛto 'dīna.abhihāsya.jihma.bhrukuṭī.kṣaṇaḥ kāma.krodha.lobha.stambha.cāpala.upatāpa.paiśunya.hīnaḥ śaklaḥ smita.udagra.abhibhāṣī vṛddha.upadeśa.ācāra ity ātma.sampat

lines_iast: amātya.sampad uktā purastāt

words.gloss: free from mud, rocks, saline land, uneven ground, thorns, bands, savage beasts and forest tribes
possessing crown lands, mines, timber forests and elephant forests
with water routes and land routes
with valuable, varied and abundant goods
able to bear the army and taxes
with masters who are not foolish and mostly of the lower varṇas

hindi: मध्य में और सीमा पर दृढ़ स्थानों से युक्त, आपत्ति में अपना और दूसरों का भरण करने में समर्थ, अपनी रक्षा स्वयं करने योग्य, अपनी आजीविका स्वयं चलाने वाला, शत्रु से द्वेष रखने वाला, वश में रखने योग्य सामन्तों वाला, कीचड़, पत्थर, ऊसर, ऊँची-नीची भूमि, काँटों, दलों, हिंस्र पशुओं और वन्य जातियों से रहित, रमणीय, कृषि-भूमि, खानों, लकड़ी के वनों और हाथियों के वनों से युक्त, गायों के लिए उपयुक्त, मनुष्यों के लिए उपयुक्त, सुरक्षित चरागाहों वाला, पशुओं से भरा, वर्षा पर निर्भर न रहने वाला, जल-मार्गों और स्थल-मार्गों से युक्त, मूल्यवान, विविध और प्रचुर पण्य वाला, सेना और कर सहने में समर्थ, परिश्रमी किसानों वाला, जिसके स्वामी मूर्ख न हों और जिसमें अधिकतर निम्न वर्णों के लोग हों, तथा जहाँ के मनुष्य भक्त और शुचि हों — यह जनपद की सम्पत् है।
english: Having strongholds both in the centre and at the frontiers, able to sustain itself and others in adversity, easily defended by itself, self-sustaining in livelihood, hostile to the enemy, having controllable neighbouring princes, free from mud, rocks, saline land, uneven ground, thorns, bands, savage beasts and forest tribes, attractive, possessing crown lands, mines, timber forests and elephant forests, suited to cattle, suited to men, with protected pastures, rich in animals, not dependent on rain, provided with water routes and land routes, with valuable, varied and abundant goods, able to bear the burden of the army and of taxes, with industrious farmers, with masters who are not foolish and (a population) mostly of the lower varṇas, with loyal and honest men: this is the excellence of the country.
notes: śreṇī: 'bands' (of robbers) or 'corporations'; aṭavī: 'forests' or 'forest tribes' (both possible). sītā: crown (agricultural) land. abāliśa-svāmi-avara-varṇa-prāya read as one bahuvrīhi: 'whose masters/landholders are not foolish and whose people are mostly of the lower varṇas'; alternatively 'mostly with non-foolish masters and lower varṇas'. pauruṣeya: 'suited to men' (habitable, rich in men).
lines_deva: मध्ये च-अन्ते च स्थानवान् आत्म.धारणः पर.धारणश् च-आपदि स्व.आरक्षः स्व.आजीवः शत्रु.द्वेषी शक्य.सामन्तः पङ्क.पाषाण.उषर.विषम.कण्टक.श्रेणी.व्याल.मृग.अटवी.हीनः कान्तः सीता.खनि.द्रव्य.हस्ति.वनवान् गव्यः पौरुषेयो गुप्त.गोचरः पशुमान् अदेव.मातृको वारि.स्थल.पथाभ्याम् उपेतः सार.चित्र.बहु.पण्यो दण्ड.कर.सहः कर्म.शील.कर्षको ऽबालिश.स्वाम्य्.अवर.वर्ण.प्रायो भक्त.शुचि.मनुष्य इति जन.पद.सम्पत्
lines_iast: madhye ca-ante ca sthānavān ātma.dhāraṇaḥ para.dhāraṇaś ca-āpadi sva.ārakṣaḥ sva.ājīvaḥ śatru.dveṣī śakya.sāmantaḥ paṅka.pāṣāṇa.uṣara.viṣama.kaṇṭaka.śreṇī.vyāla.mṛga.aṭavī.hīnaḥ kāntaḥ sītā.khani.dravya.hasti.vanavān gavyaḥ pauruṣeyo gupta.gocaraḥ paśumān adeva.mātṛko vāri.sthala.pathābhyām upetaḥ sāra.citra.bahu.paṇyo daṇḍa.kara.sahaḥ karma.śīla.karṣako 'bāliśa.svāmy.avara.varṇa.prāyo bhakta.śuci.manuṣya iti jana.pada.sampat

english: The excellence of the fort has been stated before.
lines_deva: दुर्ग.सम्पद् उक्ता पुरस्तात्
lines_iast: durga.sampad uktā purastāt

words.gloss: consisting mostly of gold and silver
with varied and large gems and bullion

hindi: पूर्वजों द्वारा या स्वयं धर्मपूर्वक अर्जित, अधिकतर सोने और चाँदी से युक्त, विविध और बड़े रत्नों तथा स्वर्ण वाला, जो बिना आय के लम्बी आपत्ति को भी सह सके — यह कोश की सम्पत् है।
english: Acquired through dharma by predecessors or by himself, consisting mostly of gold and silver, with varied and large gems and bullion, (such that) it would withstand even a long calamity without income: this is the excellence of the treasury.
notes: anāyati: 'without (further) income' (āyati = income/future revenue); hiraṇya rendered 'bullion' (gold coin/metal).
lines_deva: धर्म.अधिगतः पूर्वैः स्वयं वा हेम.रूप्य.प्रायश् चित्र.स्थूल.रत्न.हिरण्यो दीर्घाम् अप्य् आपदम् अनायतिं सहेत-इति कोश.सम्पत्
lines_iast: dharma.adhigataḥ pūrvaiḥ svayaṃ vā hema.rūpya.prāyaś citra.sthūla.ratna.hiraṇyo dīrghām apy āpadam anāyatiṃ saheta-iti kośa.sampat

words.gloss: whose sons and wives are content and provided for
skilled in the science of all fighting and weapons
because it shares prosperity and decline

hindi: पिता-पितामह से चली आई, स्थायी, आज्ञाकारी, जिसके पुत्र और स्त्रियाँ सन्तुष्ट और भरण-पोषण से युक्त हों, अभियानों में निराश न की गई, सर्वत्र अप्रतिहत, दुःख सहने वाली, अनेक युद्धों का अनुभव रखने वाली, सब प्रकार के युद्ध और शस्त्र-विद्या में निपुण, वृद्धि और क्षय में साझेदार होने के कारण द्विधा-भाव से रहित, अधिकतर क्षत्रियों से बनी — यह दण्ड की सम्पत् है।
english: Inherited from father and grandfather, permanent, obedient, with sons and wives content and provided for, not disappointed on expeditions abroad, unchecked everywhere, enduring hardship, having fought many battles, skilled in the science of all fighting and weapons, not of divided loyalty because it shares prosperity and decline, consisting mostly of Kṣatriyas: this is the excellence of the army.
notes: avisaṃvādita: 'not deceived/let down' (on expeditions, e.g. in pay); advaidhya: 'free from duplicity/division' (not likely to turn).
lines_deva: पितृ.पैतामहो नित्यो वश्यस् तुष्ट.भृत.पुत्र.दारः प्रवासेष्व् अविसंवादितः सर्वत्र-अप्रतिहतो दुःख.सहो बहु.युद्धः सर्व.युद्ध.प्रहरण.विद्या.विशारदः सह.वृद्धि.क्षयिकत्वाद् अद्वैध्यः क्षत्र.प्राय इति दण्ड.सम्पत्
lines_iast: pitṛ.paitāmaho nityo vaśyas tuṣṭa.bhṛta.putra.dāraḥ pravāseṣv avisaṃvāditaḥ sarvatra-apratihato duḥkha.saho bahu.yuddhaḥ sarva.yuddha.praharaṇa.vidyā.viśāradaḥ saha.vṛddhi.kṣayikatvād advaidhyaḥ kṣatra.prāya iti daṇḍa.sampat

words.gloss: rising in great force and quickly

hindi: पिता-पितामह से चला आया, स्थायी, वश में रहने वाला, द्विधा-भाव से रहित, बड़े बल के साथ और शीघ्र उठ खड़ा होने वाला — यह मित्र की सम्पत् है।
english: Inherited from father and grandfather, permanent, amenable, not of divided loyalty, rising (to help) in great force and quickly: this is the excellence of the ally.
notes: mahal.laghu: mahat + laghu with t > l sandhi; 'mahat' taken as 'great (force/numbers)', 'laghu' as 'quickly'. The adjectives are neuter agreeing with mitram. Alternative: mahat-laghu as a dvandva 'great and small', i.e. an ally that rises (to help) in great and small matters alike, or with a large or a small force.
lines_deva: पितृ.पैतामहं नित्यं वश्यम् अद्वैध्यं महल्.लघु.समुत्थम् इति मित्र.सम्पत्
lines_iast: pitṛ.paitāmahaṃ nityaṃ vaśyam advaidhyaṃ mahal.laghu.samuttham iti mitra.sampat

hindi: राजवंश में उत्पन्न न हुआ, लोभी, क्षुद्र परिषद् वाला, जिसकी प्रजा विरक्त हो, अन्यायपूर्ण आचरण वाला, काम में असावधान, व्यसनी, उत्साहहीन, दैव पर भरोसा करने वाला, कार्यों में जैसे-तैसे चलने वाला, अनुयायियों से रहित, कायर और सदा अपकार करने वाला — यह अमित्र की सम्पत् है।
english: Not of royal seed, greedy, having a mean council, with disaffected subjects, of unjust conduct, not attentive to work, addicted to vices, without energy, relying on fate, acting at random in affairs, without a following, cowardly and always doing harm: this is the excellence of the enemy.
notes: ananubandha: 'without a following/support'; alternative 'not looking to consequences'. yat-kiñcana-kārya-gati: literally 'whose course in affairs is whatever-it-may-be'. 'excellence of the enemy' = the qualities that make an enemy ideal from the conqueror's side (cf. unit 14).
lines_deva: अराज.बीजी लुब्धः क्षुद्र.परिषत्को विरक्त.प्रकृतिर् अन्याय.वृत्तिर् अयुक्तो व्यसनी निरुत्साहो दैव.प्रमाणो यत्.किञ्चन.कार्य.गतिर् अननुबन्धः क्लीबो नित्य.अपकारी च-इत्य् अमित्र.सम्पत्
lines_iast: arāja.bījī lubdhaḥ kṣudra.pariṣatko virakta.prakṛtir anyāya.vṛttir ayukto vyasanī nirutsāho daiva.pramāṇo yat.kiñcana.kārya.gatir ananubandhaḥ klībo nitya.apakārī ca-ity amitra.sampat

hindi: क्योंकि ऐसा शत्रु उखाड़ फेंकने में सरल होता है।
english: For an enemy of such a kind is easy to exterminate.
lines_deva: एवं.भूतो हि शत्रुः सुखः समुच्छेत्तुं भवति
lines_iast: evaṃ.bhūto hi śatruḥ sukhaḥ samucchettuṃ bhavati

words.gloss: having the full rise of their own qualities

hindi: शत्रु को छोड़कर ये सात प्रकृतियाँ, अपने-अपने गुणों के उत्कर्ष से युक्त, अपने स्वाभाविक रूप में राजा की सम्पत् कही गई हैं, जो अंग-रूप हैं।
english: These seven constituent elements, excluding the enemy, endowed with the full rise of their own qualities, are declared, in their proper form, to be the excellences of the king, being the limbs.
notes: prakṛtāḥ: taken as 'in their proper (natural) form'; alternative 'the ones under discussion'. ari-varjāḥ: the enemy (unit 13) is the eighth and is left out of the seven.
lines_deva: अरि.वर्जाः प्रकृतयः सप्त-एताः स्व.गुण.उदयाः
उक्ताः प्रत्यङ्ग.भूतास् ताः प्रकृता राज.सम्पदः
lines_iast: ari.varjāḥ prakṛtayaḥ sapta-etāḥ sva.guṇa.udayāḥ
uktāḥ pratyaṅga.bhūtās tāḥ prakṛtā rāja.sampadaḥ

hindi: आत्मवान् राजा सम्पत्-हीन प्रकृतियों को सम्पन्न बना देता है; और अनात्मवान् राजा समृद्ध और अनुरक्त प्रकृतियों को नष्ट कर देता है।
english: A self-possessed king brings constituent elements that lack excellence to excellence; a king who is not self-possessed destroys constituent elements that are flourishing and loyal.
notes: ātmavān: 'possessed of self', i.e. self-controlled, disciplined.
lines_deva: सम्पादयत्य् असम्पन्नाः प्रकृतीर् आत्मवान् नृपः
विवृद्धाश् च-अनुरक्ताश् च प्रकृतीर् हन्त्य् अनात्मवान्
lines_iast: sampādayaty asampannāḥ prakṛtīr ātmavān nṛpaḥ
vivṛddhāś ca-anuraktāś ca prakṛtīr hanty anātmavān

hindi: तब वह अनात्मवान् राजा, चाहे चारों दिशाओं के अन्त तक की पृथ्वी का स्वामी ही क्यों न हो, अपनी प्रकृतियों के बिगड़ जाने पर या तो उन्हीं प्रकृतियों द्वारा मारा जाता है या शत्रुओं के वश में चला जाता है।
english: Then that king who is not self-possessed, with his constituents corrupted, even if he rules the earth to its four ends, is either killed by his constituents or passes into the power of his enemies.
notes: cāturanta: 'whose (realm) has the four ends', i.e. ruler of the whole earth.
lines_deva: ततः स दुष्ट.प्रकृतिश् चातुरन्तो ऽप्य् अनात्मवान्
हन्यते वा प्रकृतिभिर् याति वा द्विषतां वशम्
lines_iast: tataḥ sa duṣṭa.prakṛtiś cāturanto 'py anātmavān
hanyate vā prakṛtibhir yāti vā dviṣatāṃ vaśam

hindi: किन्तु आत्मवान् राजा, छोटे से देश का स्वामी होने पर भी, प्रकृतियों की सम्पत् से युक्त और नीति को जानने वाला होकर समस्त पृथ्वी को अवश्य जीत लेता है, पराजित नहीं होता।
english: But a self-possessed king, even with a small territory, endowed with excellence of the constituents and knowing policy, conquers the whole earth indeed and does not fail.
notes: hīyate: 'is left behind / fails, is defeated'. nayajña written without a dot in the e-text but is a compound naya-jña.
lines_deva: आत्मवांस् त्व् अल्प.देशो ऽपि युक्तः प्रकृति.सम्पदा
नयज्ञः पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां जयत्य् एव न हीयते
lines_iast: ātmavāṃs tv alpa.deśo 'pi yuktaḥ prakṛti.sampadā
nayajñaḥ pṛthivīṃ kṛtsnāṃ jayaty eva na hīyate
